message:
Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_18562",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config",
    "line":458,"var":"chr","code":"if (chr == '\\'' && !strncmp(lexer->pos, \"''\", 2))",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Input-controlled character triggers entry into multiline string lexing when input starts with triple single-quotes"},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string",
    "line":342,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"advance_n(lexer, strlen(\"'''\") - 1);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Advances pos past the opening triple-quote delimiter, positioning it for the scanning loop"},
   {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string",
    "line":345,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"if (!strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3))",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"strncmp reads 3 bytes from lexer->pos without checking that pos+3 <= lexer->end; when pos is within 2 bytes of the buffer end, it reads past the buffer boundary"},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string",
    "line":345,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3) reads past global buffer",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"3-byte read at lexer->pos overflows past the end of the 32768-byte static_data global buffer, triggering global-buffer-overflow"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config",
     "line":458,"operands":["chr","lexer->pos"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string",
     "line":345,"operands":["lexer->pos","lexer->end"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"lexer->pos + 3","right":"lexer->end"}},
   "sink":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string",
     "line":345,"operands":["lexer->pos","end"],
     "relation":{"op":"ge","left":"lexer->pos + 2","right":"lexer->end"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config",
       "line":458,"operands":["lexer->pos"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string",
       "line":342,"operands":["lexer->pos"]},
      "type":"data","via":["lexer->pos"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"lexer->pos","right":"lexer->start + 3"}},
     {"from":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string",
       "line":342,"operands":["lexer->pos"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string",
       "line":345,"operands":["lexer->pos"]},
      "type":"data","via":["lexer->pos"],
      "relation":{"op":"ge","left":"lexer->pos","right":"lexer->end"}}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
